title: ScrapeCreators/social-media-research-skills: agent skills for public social research
friendlyTitle: A skill pack that lets agents research social media
summary: This Python repository packages agent skills for social-media research: outlier posts, comment mining, competitor teardowns, ad libraries, and trends across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, and others. The project says it is powered by ScrapeCreators and works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It has 4,022 stars and gained 140 stars on GitHub's Python trending list today.
friendlySummary: This project gives coding agents ready-made skills for social-media research, such as finding unusual posts, reading comments, and checking ad libraries. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It has 4,022 stars and gained 140 stars on GitHub today.
whyItMatters: A coding agent can use the skills to pull a research brief from public social platforms without you writing a separate script for each site. It is not a local-only tool: the repository says the data comes through ScrapeCreators, so check that service's access and price before you point an agent at it.
